clips.title: The story
paras: Near Greatwood Vale, Seereth Stonebreak watches the land's disturbances. The orc shaman camps on the border of the Stonetalon Mountains and the Barrens, guiding travelers against environmental ruin, rogue machines, and rising tensions in Kalimdor.

Seereth Stonebreak watches over Horde lands from her camp near Greatwood Vale. An orc shaman, she follows the harmony of the elements and protects the territories of the Horde. The land's spirits cried out against goblin plunder, and the Horde sent her to Stonetalon. There, she watches the landscape and guides travelers against dangers threatening the wild frontier.

Seereth Stonebreak is troubled by turmoil across the Stonetalon range. Ruthless goblin ventures and mechanical shredders cutting through ancient woodlands have badly fractured the mountains' spiritual balance. She sends Horde envoys to confront the invaders and seek counsel from elder lorekeepers, in hopes of easing the land's distress.
